description: Use this when an owner or HR person wants PTO balances for a team: one PTO, vacation or sick leave balance per employee from one accrual policy (accrual_amount + accrual_unit + accrual_per, e.g. 15, days, year) and a list of employees (typed, pasted CSV, or an attached CSV/Excel file with name, hire date, starting balance, hours used). Applies the same policy options as calculate_pto_balance (per hour worked, per pay period, annual front-loaded or accrued, tenure tiers, caps, carryover and reset, waiting period). Returns each person's balance, hours used this year, year-end projection and hours at risk at the reset, team totals, and PDF, Excel (with each person's ledger) and CSV files. Does not give legal advice, process payroll, or compute PTO payout in money. For one person's dated ledger use calculate_pto_balance.

accrual_amount.description: Preferred way to give the rule: the amount earned, e.g. 15 (with accrual_unit days, accrual_per year), 4.62 (hours per pay_period) or 0.0333 (hours per hour_worked).

accrual_method.description: How PTO is earned: per_hour_worked (e.g. 1 h per 30 h worked), per_pay_period (fixed hours each paycheck, e.g. 4.62 h), annual_front_loaded (whole year granted at once on the reset date), annual_accrued_per_period (yearly amount, e.g. 15 days, spread evenly over pay periods). Optional: inferred from the other fields.

accrual_per.description: How often accrual_amount is earned: year, month, week, pay_period, or hour_worked. Required for hours; days or weeks without it are read as per year.

accrual_rate.description: Fallback only, when you cannot fill accrual_amount/accrual_unit/accrual_per: the rule as text with a number, unit and period, e.g. "1 per 30", "4.62 hours per paycheck", "15 days a year". Hours without a period are refused.

accrual_unit.description: Unit of accrual_amount: hours (default), days, or weeks (weeks = days_per_week x hours_per_day).

annual_accrual_cap.description: Most hours that can be earned in one accrual year, e.g. 48.

annual_days.description: Days of PTO per year, e.g. 15. Converted with hours_per_day (default 8).

annual_hours.description: Hours of PTO per year, e.g. 120. Use instead of annual_days.

as_of_date.description: Date to report the balance on, e.g. 2026-10-26. Default: today in US Eastern time.

carryover_limit.description: Hours that may roll over at the reset date, e.g. 40. 0 = use it or lose it. Leave out for unlimited rollover.

days_per_week.description: Workdays per week, default 5. Converts weeks of PTO to hours.

accrual_rate.description: Override accrual rate for this person, e.g. 0.05.

annual_days.description: Override days per year for this person, e.g. 20.

hours_worked_per_period.description: Hours per pay period for part-time staff, e.g. 48.

name.description: Employee name, e.g. Dana Kim (shortened to 80 characters).

starting_balance.description: Balance on starting_balance_date in hours, e.g. 12.

used_hours.description: PTO hours used since the starting date (or this accrual year), e.g. 24.

employees.description: The team: a list of employees, or CSV text with a header such as "name,hire_date,starting_balance,used_hours" and one row per person. Up to 500.

employees_file.description: Optional CSV or Excel (.xlsx) file of employees with columns like name, hire date, starting balance, hours used, e.g. team-pto.csv.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

first_year.description: For annual_front_loaded: prorated (default, first grant prorated by days left in the year) or full.

hire_date.description: Hire (start) date, e.g. 2024-03-04. Used for tenure tiers, the waiting period and the first partial pay period.

hours_per_day.description: Hours in one PTO day, default 8, e.g. 7.5.

hours_per_week.description: Standard hours per week, default 40, e.g. 30 for part time. Used when hours worked are not given.

date.description: Any date in the pay period, e.g. 2026-01-09.

hours.description: Hours worked that pay period, e.g. 72.

hours_worked.description: Actual hours worked per pay period for per_hour_worked, e.g. [{"date":"2026-01-09","hours":72}] or "2026-01-09: 72, 2026-01-23: 80". Periods not listed use the standard hours.

hours_worked_per_period.description: Hours worked in each pay period, for per_hour_worked when it differs from the standard (40 h/week), e.g. 64.

max_balance.description: Maximum balance (accrual stops at this cap until hours are used), in hours, e.g. 240, or "30 days".

pay_date.description: Any real payday for weekly or biweekly pay, e.g. 2026-01-09, so accruals land on the right Fridays. Default: the first Friday on or after the ledger start.

pay_frequency.description: Pay schedule: weekly, biweekly (default, every two weeks), semimonthly (15th and last day), or monthly.

reset_date.description: When the accrual year resets (carryover is applied), e.g. "01-01" (default January 1), "July 1", or "anniversary" (hire anniversary), or "none".

starting_balance.description: Known balance on starting_balance_date, in hours, e.g. 32.5 (from a pay stub), or "4 days".

starting_balance_date.description: Date of the starting balance, e.g. 2026-01-01. Default: the start of the current accrual year (or the hire date if later).

accrual_rate.description: Or a rate in the method's unit, e.g. 0.0577 per hour worked or 6.15 per pay period.

annual_days.description: Days per year in this tier, e.g. 15.

annual_hours.description: Hours per year in this tier, e.g. 120.

from_year.description: Completed years of service when this tier starts, e.g. 0, 3, 6.

tenure_tiers.description: Tenure tiers (years of service), as text "0-2: 10 days, 3-5: 15 days, 6+: 20 days" or a list [{"from_year":0,"annual_days":10},{"from_year":3,"annual_days":15}]. "years 3-5" starts at the 3rd work anniversary.

waiting_period.description: Waiting period after hire before PTO can be used, e.g. "90 days" or "3 months".

waiting_period_rule.description: accrue_but_locked (default: hours accrue from hire but cannot be used until the waiting period ends) or no_accrual (nothing accrues during the waiting period).

title: Calculate team PTO balances
